question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a white ball, Bob has a gold ball, and Claire has a blue ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Alice swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Finally, Claire and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) white ball
(B) gold ball
(C) blue ball
solution:
Ball colors in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: white, gold, blue
1. Claire ↔ Alice: blue, gold, white
2. Bob ↔ Claire: blue, white, gold
3. Claire ↔ Alice: gold, white, blue
Alice has the gold ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
